definitions.locus: The set of all points satisfying a specified distance or position condition.
definitions.equidistant: At the same distance from specified points, lines, or other objects.
definitions.boundary: The locus separating geometric regions, often where two distances tie.
definitions.intersection: Points common to two geometric sets or loci.
definitions.tangent: A line touching a curve locally at a point; for a circle it is perpendicular to the radius there.
definitions.parabola: A locus whose points are equidistant from a fixed focus and directrix.
definitions.focus: A fixed point used to define a parabola.
definitions.directrix: A fixed line used with the focus to define a parabola.
definitions.Voronoi region: The points nearest to one seed than to any other seed, with ties on the boundary.
